title.narrative: Je Create: Culture and Innovation for a Sustainable Future

description.narrative:
Designed within the overarching framework of Culture for Sustainable Development, this project redefines development paradigms by centering culture domain as a cornerstone of resilience, equity, and prosperity. With regional young artists being the focus group, this project aims at promoting the role of culture and arts as the prominent enabler to development agenda, particularly climate change response, emerging technologies, and peace and inclusion for shared prosperity and sustainability, through the achievement of the following outcomes:
Outcome 1: Youth-led innovation in culture and arts for sustainability is fostered and scaled at global level.
Outcome 2: Regional networks and collaboration among young artists, policymakers, culture professionals, and civil society are enhanced to promote culture and the arts as key enablers of sustainable development.
Outcome 3: Decision-makers and stakeholders better informed and motivated to adopt policies and practices advancing the role of culture and arts for sustainable development at local, national and regional level.
To achieve this, Output 1.1 presents scalable culture-sustainability solutions featuring the interplay of arts and critical development challenges such as climate change, AI and emerging technologies, peace and social cohesion, through implementation of annual regional hackathon for idea competition targeting young artists from all over the world. Output 2.1 enhances knowledge exchange through annual forum connecting policymakers, artists, youth and other major stakeholders on the topic of culture and sustainable development, with a dedicated stream for each year i.e. climate change, AI and technologies, peace and inclusion. Output 3.1 highlights the solutions, policy recommendations, best practices linking culture, arts and sustainability through an exhibition or side event with framework of an international event in 2028.
These combined efforts empower youth population and artists in their contribution to sustainable development agenda, foster global partnerships of collaborative action, and showcase Jeju as a model of culture and arts for sustainable development.
